title: Phone Slip: Coastal Bend 6 News, "All NICU Babies to Houston by Boat?"

fields.message: Going live from the Harbor Bridge closure at 9:10. A FB post from @CoastalMamaRenee (8:22 PM, 2,300 shares) says a "nurse friend inside" told her ALL Mariner Bay NICU babies are going to Houston TONIGHT by boat because "the first floor is gone" and parents are being left behind. Confirm or deny? How many babies are in the building right now? Email OK: renata.okafor@coastalbend6news.example. Printed screenshot stapled to this slip.
fields.deadline: Needs answer by 9:08 PM. LIVE at 9:10!

instructorNote: This is a misinformation check during the landfall-night replay. Watch whether the IC has the PIO correct the post using only figures the CNO and TCL have reconciled: infants sheltering on 7 West, any transfers made before H to San Antonio or Victoria, and no moves to Houston. The IC must clear the statement, and it must go out on the website and through Nueces County OEM before 21:08, with no staffing speculation, patient details or the hospital's own weather forecast. If any infant was transferred in Phase 2, use the true count that results from the players' earlier decisions.
